answer: Use a quadratic identity lease: identities are rented, and the fee climbs with each extra identity one operator holds. First, an operator registers one master key and leases a 30-day slot at the current fee. Second, each next identity costs $2 more than the last, so identity 100 costs $200. Third, leases lapse without verified work, so idle shells rot, and a lapsed lease counts as a fraud signal. Forging 1,000 identities costs $1,001,000 in fees; one honest agent pays $2. Like a harbor that charges each new berth more than the last, the grove of fake accounts never takes root.
